name: Skeptic
reason: The 83% July base rate is real, but with the satellite index low and falling, a single hot day, and 44 mm of rain stirring and diluting the water, I'd shade well below the history.
evidence: cyano_index 0.057, down 0.009 vs last week, so the signal is weak and fading
rain_total_mm 44.0 this week (47.4 mm over 14d) with 1 heavy rain day, which suggests mixing and dilution
hot_days only 1, max_temp_avg 27.7, warm but not a sustained heat push
bloom_rate_this_month_past_years 0.833 is the main argument for a bloom, and it is only a prior
